sources.snippet: Gemma 4 is Google DeepMind's latest open model family, launched on March 31, 2026 and announced publicly on April 2, 2026. It is designed for advanced reasoning, agentic workflows, multimodal understanding, and efficient deployment across phones, laptops, workstations, and edge devices. sources.title: Gemma 4 model card | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 features a context window of up to 256K tokens and maintains multilingual support in over 140 languages. Featuring both Dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, Gemma 4 is well-suited for tasks like text generation, coding, and reasoning. The models are available in five distinct sizes: E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, and 31B.
